asked.item: Which number is the real one (12.7K vs 11K)
Is something broken with the connection
Do I need to reconnect YouTube

verdict.reason: The YouTube view count FAQ explains the gap between the watch page and Blotato and says no action is needed.

steps.text: Blotato and the YouTube watch page count views differently, so the two numbers never match exactly.
The watch page count includes views YouTube has not validated yet, while Blotato's count comes from the YouTube Analytics API, which reports only finalized views.
Neither is a bug and no action is needed.
The gap is widest on a new video and narrows as YouTube finalizes more data, and the Blotato number rises at later checkpoints.
To confirm this yourself, open YouTube Studio, where the Analytics tab matches what Blotato reports.
